audit.why: Thresh's hook/dive kit outpressures dash-less Seraphine every stage; chart already agrees full/content and matches the packet's all-Thresh rows.
Level 2 E-Q punish before she stacks notes, Level 6 Box vs a group-only Encore, and first-item hook-range dives are all grounded in the real kit.
Beat Drop is correctly attributed to E (the root/slow, 11s-9s cd) and High Note correctly attributed to Q (the poke zone, 8s-6s cd) throughout content and full — no mislabeled ability names.

edits.before: - Seraphine Beat Drop (Root): matchup-defining — Roots the already-slowed — dodge it and the song never builds. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Dark Passage answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Seraphine's Beat Drop (E): 11s cooldown early — roots the already-slowed, so dodge it and the song never builds. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your lantern (W) answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.

edits.before: Hook the gap, flay the landing, lantern the collapse — the full sentence pays the whole team.
edits.after: Her High Note (Q) is only an 8s-cooldown poke zone — step through it with E-Flay rather than trading autos at her comfort range.

edits.before: Fishing predictably while the souls walk past — the collection IS the scaling; greed the hooks, not the chips.
